2608.19842.title: SAPO: Single-Rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2608.19842.paper_summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has become a critical stage in the post-training of large language models. Existing critic-free, group-relative methods estimate policy advantages from multiple rollouts, avoiding the substantial memory overhead of conventional proximal policy optimization (PPO) and achieving strong performance on long-horizon interactive tasks. Despite their success, recent studies revealed three limitations: (1) Lack explicit value generalization and effective temporal credit assignment; (2) Suffer from potential advantage collapse in long-horizon complex tasks; (3) Require a costly trade-off between sampling budget and policy performance. In this work, we propose Single-rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization (SAPO), a low-memory and compute-efficient framework in which the policy and value functions share a single autoregressive backbone. SAPO exploits the autoregressive structure of LLMs to produce policy and value predictions at distinct causal boundaries with shared parameters, while independently optimizing the PPO objectives and auxiliary on-policy SARSA objectives. To robustly estimate the contribution of each turn, we further introduce a trajectory-level generalized advantage estimator that combines lambda-returns with batch normalization. Experiments across ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B show that SAPO trains stably and outperforms PPO and GRPO by mean +15.1 and +12.1 percentage points, respectively, while eliminating the memory cost of a separate critic model and reducing per-iteration runtime by 33.2% over PPO.
2608.19842.paper_summary_zh: 代理強化學習（RL）已成為大型語言模型後訓練中的一個關鍵階段。現有的無評論者、群體相對方法從多次回合中估計策略優勢，避免了傳統近端策略優化（PPO）帶來的巨大內存開銷，並在長期互動任務中取得了良好的表現。儘管取得了成功，最近的研究揭示了三個限制：（1）缺乏明確的價值泛化和有效的時間信用分配；（2）在長期複雜任務中可能遭受優勢崩潰的風險；（3）需要在取樣預算和策略表現之間進行昂貴的權衡。在本研究中，我們提出了單次回合自回歸策略優化（SAPO），這是一個低內存和計算效率高的框架，其中策略和值函數共享一個單一的自回歸骨幹。SAPO 利用大型語言模型的自回歸結構，在共享參數的情況下，在不同的因果邊界生成策略和值預測，同時獨立優化PPO目標和輔助的在政策SARSA目標。為了穩健地估計每一回合的貢獻，我們進一步引入了一個軌跡級別的廣義優勢估計器，將lambda回報與批量正規化相結合。在ALFWorld和WebShop上進行的實驗顯示，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B的SAPO訓練穩定，並分別比PPO和GRPO的平均表現提高了+15.1和+12.1個百分點，同時消除了單獨評論者模型的內存成本，並將每次迭代的運行時間減少了33.2%。
